blocks.text: Alag alag zarooraton ke liye cloud services ki alag alag qismein hain. Aam taur par cloud services teen bari qismon mein baanti jati hain: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) aur Software as a Service (SaaS). Har qism control, flexibility (zaroorat ke mutabiq badal sakna) aur management (sambhalna) ka alag level deti hai, aur alag zarooraton aur istemal ke liye theek rehti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: IaaS mein provider sirf mashinein (servers, storage, network) deta hai, baqi sab aap sambhalte hain. PaaS mein provider tayyar platform bhi deta hai, aap sirf apna program likhte aur chalate hain. SaaS mein poori application tayyar milti hai, aap bas istemal karte hain. IaaS se SaaS ki taraf jayein to aasani barhti aur control kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Cloud services ki qismein bata kar un ka comparison (saath rakh kar farq dekhna) kijiye (exercise long question 3).
blocks.explanation: IaaS basic infrastructure (virtual servers, storage, networking) kiraye par deta hai; operating system aur us se upar sab user sambhalta hai (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Compute Engine). PaaS is ke saath middleware, development tools aur management services bhi deta hai, to developers sirf code likhte aur deploy karte hain (Google App Engine, Microsoft Azure App Services, Heroku). SaaS poora software internet par deta hai; user ko na hardware sambhalna na updates karne (Gmail, Google Docs, Microsoft Office 365, Salesforce). IaaS mein sab se zyada control, SaaS mein sab se zyada aasani.

items: Har qism ka control, flexibility aur management ka level alag.
